messages:
Ana (marketing): T-minus 72h. Final checklist: changelog link, docs URL, webinar RSVP, benchmark blurbs, and inbound lead routing. Who can confirm canary window and rollback point?
Mike (eng): Canary starts Tue 09:00 PST, 4h window, auto-rollup to previous model at failure threshold. Planning a 10% traffic canary -> 50% -> 100% unless errors spike.
Ana (marketing): Got it. Can you post the exact changelog snippet we should paste in the announcement? Want a 1-2 line highlight + bullets.
Mike (eng): Short snippet below, use the first line as the blurb.
Mike (eng): ```
Runtime: improved KV-cache effectiveness -> ~15% p95 token latency improvement for long-context workloads.
Bugfix: fixed rare OOM during concurrent batching on A100s.
Feature: added model fallback routing for overloaded regions.
```
Sam (product): Messaging suggestion: "Lower latency at scale — 15% p95 improvement for extended contexts. Predictable fallbacks for global availability." Use that as headline.
Julia (docs): Docs link is live at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3.2 — includes migration notes and sample prompts. Link short: https://redwood.ai/docs/v2.3.2
Ana (marketing): Julia, can you add a single-step code sample snippet for the blog? Something tiny showing config toggles.
Julia (docs): Added small snippet under "Quickstart". Copy below:```
# enable adaptive caching
redwood.configure({"cache": "adaptive", "batching": true})
```
Nisha (salesops): For inbound routing: map Webinar RSVPs -> SFDC Campaign "v2.3_webinar_may"; high-touch leads (company_size > 500) -> AE queue "Enterprise-North"; others -> SDR nurture. I'll push mapping by EOD.
Ana (marketing): Perfect. Who will publish the RSVP link? Need landing page + GA tracking.
Sam (product): Growth will publish landing page at 10:00 PST tomorrow. GA UTMs: utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=v2.3.2_launch.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary roll at 1716547200, full ramp expected 1716558000. See dashboard: https://infra.redwood.ai/deploys/65432
Mike (eng): One more ask — please avoid heavy traffic spikes first 30 minutes of canary. We'll throttle public links for the first hour if needed.
Ana (marketing): We'll stagger send windows. Marketing plan: staged email at +30m and +3h, social blitz after 1h.
Sam (product): Webinar: 2pm PT day after launch. Speaker list finalized. We'll add a short benchmark slide (use Mike's blurb + p95 graph).
Ana (marketing): Can someone confirm the final changelog anchor URL I should link in the announcement?
Julia (docs): Anchor: https://redwood.ai/docs/v2.3.2#changelog — verified.
Nisha (salesops): Routing test: I'll send a test RSVP with company_size=1200 to validate AE queue mapping and SFDC campaign tag.
Ana (marketing): Amazing. Final items: attach docs and changelog to internal release note, confirm webinar RSVP link, and confirm lead routing test pass. If all green, we'll ship on schedule. :thumbsup:
Mike (eng): Will monitor logs and share a short runbook in this thread before canary. :eyes:
Julia (docs): Done — added migration callouts to the top of the docs for easy linking.
Nisha (salesops): Test RSVP passed, AE queue assigned correctly.
Ana (marketing): Thanks team — I'll assemble the announcement draft with links and post for review in #marketing-drafts in 2h.
Sam (product): +1. Good luck :)
